conditions: Local container docmind-service:m7, --memory 512m --cpus 0.1, fake provider, demo corpus (3 documents / 639 chunks) in local Postgres pg17 as tenant public; measured 2026-11-05

cpu_seconds_per_request.definition: process_cpu_seconds_total delta over the 60 s run divided by completed requests, from the /metrics scrape before and after the run

note: All values exclude provider time (DOCMIND_LLM_PROVIDER=fake). The render-like profile is a local approximation of the free-tier instance shape (512 MB, 0.1 CPU).

p95_seconds.definition: End-to-end HTTP p95 of POST /v1/query for the run; with the fake provider this is the retrieval path under the 0.1 CPU cap
